name: metric3d_v2

outputs.name: pred_depth
outputs.meaning: canonical depth — NOT metres, see D12

caveats: output is canonical depth; metres need real_focal * scale / 1000 (D12)
built at fp32 while every other model is fp16

encoder.note: ConvNeXt-Tiny and ConvNeXt-Large also ship, but they are the v1 line and a different architecture, not a smaller point on this encoder axis. vits also uses a RAFT-4iter head where vitl uses 8iter, so this is not purely an encoder swap.
